description: This file contains implementation of helper functions for configuring time domain resources in a 5G NR scheduler, including generation of candidate parameters for UL/DL slot timing, PDSCH symbol start calculation, and resource list creation for PDSCH and PUSCH in TDD and FDD modes.

classes.name: time_domain_resource_helper
classes.description: Namespace containing static helper functions for time domain resource configuration in 5G NR scheduler.

methods.name: generate_k1_candidates
methods.description: Generates candidate k1 values for UL/DL slot timing based on TDD configuration.

methods.name: calculate_minimum_pdsch_symbol
methods.description: Calculates the minimum OFDM symbol index for PDSCH transmission considering CORESET and search space configurations.

methods.name: generate_dedicated_pdsch_td_res_list
methods.description: Creates a list of PDSCH time domain resource allocations based on TDD configuration and minimum symbol index.

methods.name: generate_dedicated_pusch_td_res_list
methods.description: Creates a list of PUSCH time domain resource allocations based on TDD configuration and minimum k2 value.
